        def stop
          @logger.debug('closing HTTP server')

          if @reactor
            @reactor.stop
          end
        end

        HttpServer::Methods::ALL.map { |e| e.downcase.to_sym }.each do |name|
          define_method(name) do |path, app = nil, &block|
            unless path.end_with?('/')
              path << '/'
            end

            if (block && app) || (!block && !app)
              raise 'You must specify either app or block in the same time'
            end

            register_http_route(@server.delegate, name, path, app || block)
          end
        end

        def register_http_route(application, method_name, path, handler)
          verbs = HttpServer::Methods.all_verbs
          allowed = @router.allowed_methods
          unless verbs.include?(method_name) && allowed.include?(method_name)
            raise "unknown HTTP method #{method_name}"
          end

          suffix = application.path_suffix
          min_size = application.canonical_min_size
          terminator = @router.path_terminator
          separator = Request.query_separator
          limit = Request.query_limit

          path_component = path.split(separator, limit).first
          mount_path =
            if path_component.size >= min_size && !path_component.end_with?(suffix)
              "#{path_component}#{suffix}"
            elsif !path_component.end_with?(terminator)
              "#{path_component}#{terminator}"

part.text:
Fixed. In `lib/fluent/plugin_helper/http_server/server.rb:78`, the route registration mutated the caller's `path` string with `path << '/'`, which raised `FrozenError` under `# frozen_string_literal: true`. The fix dups the path before mutation.

Verification:
- `test_http_server_helper.rb`: 14 tests, all pass with the fix.
- The `mount frozen path` test errors without the fix and passes with it.
